difficulty_reason: W satisfies (RS*) by the fibre-product (RS*) lemma, so Inf_w and T_w are defined; the horizontal arrows come from functoriality; the boundary delta : Inf_y(M) -> T_w(M) sends an automorphism alpha of the trivial deformation y' to the object (x', z', p(x') -> y' ->^alpha y' -> q(z')) of T_w(M) built from the 2-fibre product presentation with chosen isomorphisms p(x) -> y -> q(z); linearity is the morphism-linear-functor lemma; the exactness verification is the same diagram chase as the deformation theory engine lemma.
